title: 第三章 驱障第四章 修炼异处
lines: 雷涅全身颤栗，豆大的汗珠不时从额头落下。
面对这突如其来的变故，雷涅几近癫狂！
莫要说现在，让其去渡那洞府外面的真丹雷劫。就算雷涅刚突破至真丹境的全盛时期，应对这雷劫都会颇为吃力！
现在出去，无疑找死！
“冷静!一定要冷静！”
雷涅死死的将自己的心境压制住！只见其双眼一闭，脑袋里的思绪便开始飞速的运转，寻找着破解之道。
仅仅片刻功夫，雷涅便断然睁眼。
手指一并，往储物袋上一祭，瞬时间，密密麻麻的玄石盘旋于石室之内，观其品质与数量，竟然是将近数千块的中品玄石。
随后雷涅手臂急速挥动，这数千块中品玄石，带起耀眼光华，飞盾至石室上空，成螺旋状的环绕而起。
而石室上方，随着玄石环绕的加剧，竟变的透明可见。
那外面犹若灭世蛟龙的雷霆，也在此刻印入到了雷涅的眼瞳之中!
一道雷霆带着滔天声势降落而下，将下方的石室晃的已经不见其形！可，就在雷霆将要再一次轰中石室外面存在的阵法时。
那阵法突然焕发出蓬勃的青蓝之色。
一股强劲的能量犹若漫天飞沙与那恐怖的雷霆徐徐抵散消融。
反观石室内，最上方环绕的灵石，也随着雷霆的逐渐消失而幻化成一缕粉尘，飘散不见!
望着此种情景，雷涅悬着的心这才略缓，低声喃喃起来。
“还好这护府阵法能抗衡这真雷丹劫，不过即便把这数千中品玄石消耗光，也不可能将雷劫抵消掉。”
“当初被自己用阵法轰散的那诡异能量，竟然还有这么多残留自己身体中，不过观其模样应该是没有了当初的那股意识，只是此刻受我这凝成的真丹所散发的庞大能量，将其给引诱了出来!!!!”
那股黑色能量，正逐步包裹着雷涅的真丹，而当其彻底的包裹住雷涅的真丹时，雷涅将再也施展不出任何法力。
“要在这之前做点什么！”
雷涅心中暗道。
“看看此刻催动法决，其是否有所收敛！”
随后，只见雷涅开始在石室内闪转腾挪，武动出一个又一个的玄奇残影，周遭的天地能量也是在此刻，顺着雷涅修炼出的位点涌入其体内。
这些尚还没有被炼化的天地能量，在涌入至雷涅的身体后，原本还如没头苍蝇的四下乱串。
但下一刻，在雷涅的操控下，急速的朝着丹田处汇聚。
那股黑色能量似是察觉到了危险，竟停止包裹雷涅的真丹，转而与那些汇聚而来的天地能量相互纠缠了起来。
雷涅见到此景，心中一喜，加大催动法决的进度，让两者纠缠的更为剧烈。
但许久过后，只是阻止了黑色能量包裹真丹的举动，并未让其彻底的与真丹分离！
雷涅欣喜的脸上也逐渐阴沉了下来。
“难不成是法决等级太低的原因?”
雷涅不由的想到这点上，现在催动的这门法决乃是凡境小成修习的撼地决，是最普通的一门法决，雷涅之所以催动此等法决，主要还是因为，其现在不能像以往那样，直接调动体内玄气催动法决，只能催动这种先将身外玄气吸纳进体，略做聚集，而后发动的低层法决。
这种法决，因为其使用起来颇为缓慢，一般的修士跟本不会去修炼。只有像雷涅这种修炼天赋低的，会习得两三部，已做在体内法力耗尽时，保命之用。
但雷涅所掌控的其余四部法决，等级层次只不过与撼地决略有偏差而已。
即便换成其中较高者施展，所起到的效果，想来也只不过与此刻相仿而已。
“除非......法决叠加施展！但那样的话，吸纳天地能量的驳杂程度便会瞬间提高，对日后修炼影响着实不小。”
content_en:
Rene's whole body was trembling, and big beads of sweat fell from his forehead from time to time.
Faced with this sudden change, Rene almost went crazy!
Don't say that now, let him go through the true elixir thunder tribulation outside the cave. Even if Reine had just broken through to the heyday of the True Alchemy Realm, it would be quite difficult to deal with this thunder tribulation!
If you go out now, you will undoubtedly seek death!
"Calm down! You must calm down!"
Rene suppressed his state of mind tightly! As soon as his eyes closed, his thoughts began to race rapidly, looking for a solution.
In just a moment, Rene opened his eyes decisively.
He put his fingers together and offered a sacrifice to the storage bag. In an instant, dense black stones were hovering in the stone chamber. Judging from their quality and quantity, they turned out to be nearly thousands of middle-grade black stones.
Then Reine waved his arm rapidly, and these thousands of middle-grade black stones, with dazzling brilliance, flew to the sky above the stone chamber, forming a spiral circle.
The top of the stone chamber, as the black stone surround intensified, became transparent and visible.
The thunder outside, which was like a world-destroying dragon, also entered into Reine's eyes at this moment!
A bolt of thunder descended with overwhelming force, shaking the stone chamber below so that it was no longer visible! However, just when the thunder was about to hit the formation outside the stone chamber again.
The formation suddenly glowed with a vibrant blue color.
A strong energy was like flying sand all over the sky and the terrifying thunder slowly dispersed and dissolved.
Looking back at the stone chamber, the spiritual stones surrounding the top also turned into a wisp of dust and disappeared as the thunder gradually disappeared!
Looking at this scene, Rene's heart relaxed slightly and he murmured in a low voice.
"Fortunately, this palace-protecting formation can resist the true thunder pill tribulation, but even if all these thousands of middle-grade black stones are consumed, it is impossible to offset the thunder tribulation."
"The weird energy that I blasted away with my formation actually still has so much left in my body. However, judging from its appearance, it seems that it has lost its original consciousness. It is just that the huge energy emitted by my condensed true elixir has lured it out at this moment!!!!"
That black energy is gradually wrapping Renie's true elixir, and when it completely wraps Renie's true elixir, Renie will no longer be able to exert any magic power.
"We need to do something before this!"
Rene thought to himself.
"Let's see if the method has been restrained at this moment!"
Afterwards, Reine began to move around in the stone chamber, creating mysterious afterimages one after another. At this moment, the energy from the surrounding world poured into Reine's body along the points he had cultivated.
After the energy of heaven and earth, which had not yet been refined, poured into Reine's body, it was originally like a headless fly.
But the next moment, under the control of Rene, they quickly gathered towards the dantian.
The black energy seemed to be aware of the danger, and actually stopped wrapping Rene's true elixir, and instead became entangled with the gathered energy of heaven and earth.
When Rene saw this, he felt happy and increased the pace of activating the magic spell, making the entanglement between the two more intense.
But after a long time, it only prevented the black energy from wrapping the true elixir, but did not allow it to be completely separated from the true elixir!
Rene's happy face gradually turned gloomy.
"Is it possible that the magic level is too low?"
Reine couldn't help but think of this. The technique he was activating now was the Earth-Shaking Technique practiced in the mortal realm. It was the most common technique. The main reason why Reigne activated this technique was because he could not directly mobilize the profound energy in his body to activate the technique like in the past. He could only activate the low-level technique of absorbing the profound energy from outside his body into his body first, gathering it briefly, and then launching it.
This method is very slow to use, so ordinary monks would not practice it. Only those with low cultivation talents like Renye will learn two or three skills to save their lives when the mana in their bodies is exhausted.
However, the levels of the remaining four spells controlled by Reine are only slightly different from those of the Earth-Shaking Art.
Even if it were used by a higher one, the effect would be similar to what it is now.
"Unless... the spells are superimposed and used! But in that case, the degree of complexity of absorbing the energy of heaven and earth will increase instantly, which will have a great impact on future cultivation."
